items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Invokes Force Majeure On Project Jupiter While Reaffirming Commitment
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) has invoked force majeure on its multi billion dollar Project Jupiter data center due to permitting delays. The force majeure notice affects a single large scale Project Jupiter site that underpins part of Oracle's AI and cloud buildout. Bondholders tied to Project Jupiter financing are assessing how the delay could influence risk assumptions for Oracle's future capital projects. items.title: Michael Burry: Oracle Cannibalizing Cash Flow “Much Like WorldCom Did”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMichael Burry compared Oracle to WorldCom over the weekend, saying Oracle’s capital-intense AI strategy is cannibalizing its cash flow and margins, openly and without fraud. Credit markets are starting to price Oracle as a real risk: Its bonds are yielding 8%+.
